title: Last tape
style: grainy found-footage still from a handheld camcorder and headlamps, deep uncharted limestone cave, harsh white headlamp beams cutting total darkness, wet glistening rock, VHS noise and lens flare, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. The last tape shows the way out. Listen to who's holding the camera. 📼

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Lou went ahead into Cave 3, and then his voice called out to them from behind.
scenes.image: grainy still of a headlamp approaching up a dark cave tunnel

scenes.narration: Tape five. The last one. It's shaky and fast. Priya and Dev run toward the terrified voice.
scenes.image: grainy motion-blurred headlamp still of two cavers running through a narrow wet tunnel

scenes.narration: They find Lou wedged in a crevice. Pale. Shaking. He won't look back at the tunnel. He just keeps saying, it was wearing my voice.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a terrified pale man wedged into a rock crevice, hugging his knees

scenes.narration: Then the passage tilts upward. Grey light. Snow on the rocks. Daylight pouring in. The exit.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a cave tunnel opening onto bright grey daylight and snowy rocks

scenes.narration: The camera holds on it. Priya and Dev step toward the light. Lou turns at the mouth of the cave and waves the camera forward.
scenes.image: grainy still of three cavers silhouetted against a bright cave exit, one turning back to wave

scenes.narration: And the person holding the camera says, quietly: okay. I'll close this out.
scenes.image: grainy close still of the camcorder's own shadow cast on the cave wall by the daylight

scenes.narration: Everyone who knew them recognized that voice. Lou's voice. Lou's laugh. Lou's little cough. Coming from behind the camera.
scenes.image: grainy still of the cave exit, Lou clearly in the frame in daylight, smiling

scenes.narration: But Lou is in the shot. Standing in the daylight. Waving.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a smiling man in a caving helmet standing in a bright cave mouth, beckoning

scenes.narration: Investigators checked every frame. Both of them are Lou. And the case wasn't found outside. It was set down at the mouth, lens pointing in. Like someone carried it out, left it, and went back inside.
scenes.image: grainy still of a waterproof case resting at a cave mouth, facing into the darkness, snow on the rocks

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: a new series. A smart house that says goodnight to someone who isn't there.
scenes.image: sleek modern house at night with glowing windows, a soft blue light ring pulsing on a small speaker inside
